name: Order Roid
source:
Main character is a poor designer. He orders a pretty female-type android to help with business, but what he receives is opposite of his expectations - male cat ears type android. The factory persuades him to keep the asset, so strange communal life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个贫穷的设计师。他订购了一个漂亮的女性型仿生人来帮忙处理生意，但他收到的却是与他的预期相反的——雄性猫耳型仿生人。工厂说服他保留资产，奇怪的集体生活开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
